data.one_liner: Mediation adapter enabling Pangle ads via the google_mobile_ads plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bridge between the Google Mobile Ads SDK and the Pangle ad network. Allows Flutter apps to request and display Pangle ads through Google’s mediation layer.
use_when: You need Pangle ad inventory in a Flutter app
You are already using google_mobile_ads for mediation
You target both Android and iOS
avoid_when: You only need a single ad network without mediation
You require a different ad network not supported by this adapter
strengths: Supports latest Pangle adapter versions for Android and iOS
Works on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Only works with google_mobile_ads (no standalone use)
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, ensure google_mobile_ads version 9.1.0, follow Pangle native SDK integration steps (Android manifest, iOS plist, Swift Package Manager if needed)

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core ad SDK; use if you don't need Pangle mediation or prefer other networks
